plugins.name: sync-skills
plugins.description: Reconcile skills between ~/.agents/skills/ (authoritative) and ~/.claude/skills/ (runtime) — handle junctions, migrations, and lockfile backfill on Windows/macOS/Linux.

plugins.name: speedpr
plugins.description: Drive the current branch to 'Ready To Merge': auto-detect phase A→B→C→D, handle review threads (GraphQL), CI, and merge conflicts. Supports /loop for polling and an `auto` mode for merging.

plugins.name: app-factory
plugins.description: AI Native project scaffolding factory. Initialize project + configure tooling + analyze capabilities + recommend stack + install official skills + generate CLAUDE.md. Interactive/Auto modes, 10 preset scenarios, 4 deploy platforms (Cloudflare/Vercel/AWS/Docker). Also detects existing projects and suggests safe upgrades.

plugins.name: user-simulator
plugins.description: AI-driven product-level QA for Electron and Web. Spawn persona-driven agents that act like real users, run task-based or exploratory flows, capture key-node evidence, find functional/visual/UX/performance bugs, and verify fixes via Round 2 comparison. v4 adds project auto-detection (detect-project), API verification (verify-api for OpenAPI/GraphQL/REST), and a runnable Playwright scaffold for projects without an existing E2E fixture.

plugins.name: game-soundfx
plugins.description: Generate game sound effects from natural language descriptions via ByteDance Seed-TTS API. Combat, magic, environment, UI, footsteps, creatures, weapons — describe the sound in English and get a WAV/MP3/OGG file back. Supports batch generation, flexible --params passthrough, and loopable SFX for game engines.
